description.summary: the Dock's hold on what the compositor shows

protocol.description:
Reserved to the Dock (a shell component, `SILICA_SHELL=1`): the global is visible only to shell components and only one client can hold the control at a time.
On macOS the Dock drives Spaces, Mission Control, App Windows, Show Desktop, the hot corners and the minimize effect through WindowServer. This is Silica's counterpart: the compositor keeps drawing the windows (no copies are sent anywhere: live contents, shadows, glass) and the Dock decides where, how big, how opaque and whether they show, frame by frame, with the measured curves. The compositor offers primitives and reports; the Dock decides.
- The control announces every window and every layer surface as a node. A node's frame is reported; the Dock can hide it, or place it (one or several times) anywhere on the desktop at any scale, optionally clipped, and warp it as a genie. Without a request the compositor shows a node where it is, as it always does. - Requests are double-buffered on the control: they take effect together at `commit`, in one frame, so that a set of windows never moves out of step. - While the control is bound the compositor no longer runs the minimize animation, hot corner actions, space or Mission Control shortcuts and gestures: it reports them and the Dock acts. Without a Dock nothing of this happens (windows minimize without effect, there is only one space). - Input needs no request: while a view is open the Dock puts a full-screen surface on the overlay layer with exclusive keyboard focus, and the pointer and keys go to it as to any layer surface. Nodes the Dock hides do not take pointer or keyboard focus.

description.summary: gives the Dock its control
the manager is no longer needed

request.name: get_control

description.summary: takes the control

request.description: One client at a time. The compositor announces the current windows and layer surfaces as nodes, then the changes. When the control goes (destroy, or the client exits) every override it made ends: all nodes show where they are, and a minimized window is minimized without effect.

description.summary: what the Dock sees and decides
releases the control

entry.name: window
entry.summary: a toplevel: key is its ext-foreign-toplevel identifier

entry.name: layer
entry.summary: a layer surface: key is its namespace

entry.name: menu_bar
entry.summary: the menu bar strip, while an app shows in it: key is menu-bar; its placement 0 moves and fades it (scale and clip do not apply)

event.name: node

description.summary: a window or a layer surface exists

event.description: Sent for every existing node when the control is taken and for every new one after. Windows are announced when they map (the same moment as ext-foreign-toplevel-list's toplevel event), layer surfaces on their first commit. The Dock's own surfaces are nodes too (kind layer, its namespace); it leaves them alone.

request.name: commit

description.summary: applies the pending requests of every node

request.description: The pending requests of all the nodes take effect together at the next repaint. A commit with nothing pending does nothing.

request.name: set_swipe_fingers

description.summary: which swipes belong to the Dock

request.description: Swipes with this many fingers are reported with `swipe` and not delivered to apps: 3 or 4, or 0 for none (the default: every swipe goes to the app). Pinches with four or more fingers (and the thumb-and-three-fingers pinch) are always the Dock's while it holds the control.

entry.name: cancel
entry.summary: the system took the gesture back

event.name: swipe

description.summary: a swipe of the Dock's finger count

event.description: dx and dy are the movement since begin, in the unaccelerated device units the compositor receives (about 1 per logical pixel at normal speed); on the end event they are the total.

event.name: pinch

description.summary: a pinch or a spread with four or more fingers

event.description: scale is 1 at begin, below 1 while the fingers close (the launcher), above 1 while they open (Show Desktop).

event.name: corner

description.summary: the pointer reached or left a screen corner

event.description: The pointer is on the corner pixel of an output (entered 1) or left it (entered 0); modifiers are the keys held at that moment. The compositor runs no corner action: the Dock waits its own delay, picks the action of its settings (hotcorners.*) and toggles. output is the connector name.

description.summary: a window or a layer surface the Dock can place

request.name: destroy

description.summary: ends the overrides of this node

request.description: The node shows where it is again (a request pending at the next commit is dropped).

event.name: closed

description.summary: the window or surface is gone

event.description: The Dock destroys the object. Requests on a closed node are ignored.

event.name: frame

description.summary: where the node is

event.description: The rectangle of the window frame (title bar and content, without the shadow) or of the layer surface, in desktop coordinates (logical pixels), where the compositor puts it, whatever the Dock placed it at. Sent at announcement and at every change.

entry.name: minimized
entry.summary: the window is minimized (without a placement the compositor shows nothing)

entry.name: focused
entry.summary: the window has the keyboard focus

entry.name: modal
entry.summary: the window is a sheet or a dialog of another window

event.name: state

description.summary: what the compositor knows about a window

event.description: Sent at announcement and at every change; layer surfaces have no state (0).

event.name: output

description.summary: the output the node is mostly on

event.description: The connector name. Sent at announcement and when it changes.

entry.name: inherit
entry.summary: as the compositor would show it

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: not drawn, no pointer, no keyboard focus: another space

entry.name: shown
entry.summary: drawn even when minimized or its app is hidden (the minimize effect)

request.name: set_visibility

description.summary: shows or hides the node

request.description: Pending until commit. A hidden window that had the focus gives it up as if it had closed; the Dock activates the window it wants.

entry.name: stack
entry.summary: in the window stack, below the Top layer

entry.name: above_top
entry.summary: above the Top layer, below the Overlay layer (inside the Dock's spaces bar)

request.name: place

description.summary: draws the node at a position, scale and opacity

request.description:
Pending until commit. The node is drawn (live) with its frame's top-left corner at x, y (desktop coordinates, fractional), the whole frame scaled uniformly by scale (shadow included) and faded to opacity (0 to 1). A clip rectangle with a positive size cuts what is drawn to it (the thumbnail of a space in the bar). index numbers the placements of the node, from 0: a window can be drawn several times (large in the arrangement, small in the bar); placing an index again replaces it. While the node has a placement it is drawn there and nowhere else. A window that is not visible is not drawn at all.
Placements are drawn in the window stack's order for the level stack, then the ones of above_top, in the order of their nodes.

request.name: remove_placement

description.summary: stops drawing the node at an index

request.description: Pending until commit. Without placements the node is drawn where it is.

request.name: warp

description.summary: draws the node as a genie into a rectangle

request.description: Pending until commit. The window is drawn deformed into the funnel of the minimize effect towards the rectangle (desktop coordinates, the Dock cell), with the shape given by bend, top and bottom (0 to 1 each: how bent the funnel is, how far the top and bottom edges have come to the rectangle, 0 the window as it is, 1 inside the rectangle). The Dock drives them frame by frame with the measured curves. The warp replaces the placements while it lasts; the contents stay frozen at the first frame of the warp. Combine with set_visibility shown for a window that is minimizing.

request.name: activate

description.summary: gives the window the focus and brings it to the front

request.description: Applied at once, not at commit. As silica_shell_manager_v1.activate does for one window; a window the Dock hid (another space) is shown first, and a minimized one comes back. Through this node and not the shell manager so that it comes after the commit of the same connection, in order.

description.summary: stops warping the node
